Purpose:
The Committee is responsible for considering
matters relating to the composition of
the Board, including the recommendation
of potential Directors. It also makes
appropriate recommendations to the Board
and reviewing succession plans to maintain
an appropriate balance of skills on the
Board. The Committee’s responsibilities also
include corporate governance issues such as
overseeing the annual Board effectiveness
reviews, reviewing the Board’s remuneration,
the Board Charter, Conflicts of Interest
Register and ensuring appropriate on-going
training for the Board. The Committee is
further responsible for monitoring effective
strategic implementation of key aspects of
Human Resource management in the Bank.
Composition:
Comprised of upto four (4)
Non-executive Directors
